items.q: Can you remove the wall between my kitchen and living room?
items.a: Often, yes. If the wall is load-bearing, a licensed structural engineer designs the beam and posts, and we permit and build to that design.

items.q: Do I need a permit for a kitchen remodel?
items.a: Most kitchen remodels that change electrical, plumbing, gas or walls need permits in Los Angeles. We pull them and schedule inspections.
Yes. Design is part of the process. We build a finish schedule with you and tie each selection to an allowance in the contract.
After the walkthrough and design, you get a written scope and price, with named allowances for selections and a written exclusions page.
